sector_model: Financial data and index licensing, asset light subscription and asset based fees (large): value on FCF after capitalized software and SBC, retention, leverage and buybacks with negative equity; not a bank or insurer model.
thesis: MSCI (NYSE: MSCI). Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-10-20) read in part (statements, debt table, run rate, retention, cash flow). 9M26 revenue 2,609.8M vs 2,311.9M (+12.9%); Q3 892.0M; Q3 NI 351.0M; 9M NI 1,099.0M vs 917.6M; 9M operating income 1,446.5M (55.4% margin). Total run rate 3,571.9M (+12.1%): recurring subscriptions 2,596.3M (+8.8%), asset based fees 975.6M (+22.0%, market and flow sensitive). Retention rate: Index 97.2% 9M (96.1% prior), Analytics 94.6%, Sustainability and Climate 92.2% (94.0% prior). TTM (FY25 + 9M26 - 9M25, USD): revenue 3,432.4M, NI 1,383.7M, OCF 1,614.8M, capex 39.6M, capitalized software 120.6M, FCF after both 1,454.7M, SBC 126.1M. Close 636.90 (2026-11-18) x 71.7M shares (10-Q, 2026-09-30, point in time, rounded to 0.1M) = about 45.7B market cap = 33.0x TTM NI, FCF yield 3.2% (2.9% after SBC). Debt 6,716.9M (principal 6,760M) vs cash 261.0M; equity is a deficit of 3,016.4M from buybacks (1,135.8M in 9M26) and dividends (447.8M); EV about 52.1B; 174.7M of acquisitions in 9M26. The price implies durable double digit growth and sustained high margins; evidence supports quality, but 33x earnings with a 3% FCF yield is not obviously cheap; not shown to be mispriced.
counterthesis: Growth leans on asset based fees (27% of run rate, +22%) that fall with equity markets. Sustainability and Climate retention is slipping (92.2% vs 94.0%). Net debt about 6.5B with FCF fully devoted to buybacks and dividends, and the revolver drawn 810M vs 300M at year end, so capital return is partly debt financed (1,583M of buybacks and dividends in 9M26 vs 9M FCF of about 990M after software). Negative equity makes book multiples meaningless. Deferred revenue fell to 1,036.7M from 1,231.8M (seasonal). Capitalized software rose to 96.7M from 66.7M, which flatters operating cash flow relative to expense. Competition from index and data peers was not compared.
invalidation: Invalidated if retention falls below about 92% in Index or Analytics, asset based fees decline sharply with markets, interest costs on rising debt compress FCF, or buybacks continue to outrun FCF so that leverage rises.
